responsibility: Implements lowering of nested functions into explicit nonlocal-frame and static-chain form. It records nested-function relationships in cgraph summaries, builds per-function nesting trees, rewrites nonlocal variable references, nested calls, and nonlocal gotos to use generated frame fields and chain parameters, finalizes rewritten bindings and debug/VLA state, unnests functions in the call graph, and thereby converts lexically nested functions into a representation suitable for whole-function middle-end optimization and inlining.
same_name_distinction: Implements the nested-function lowering pass declared in gcc/tree-nested.h. Unlike the header’s summaries and helper declarations, this file performs the actual rewriting of nonlocal references, static-chain and frame accesses, nonlocal gotos, and callgraph unnesting/finalization.
